findings.finding: Candidate Halley uses four value-coordinate iterations rather than the canonical six-pass bi-coordinate primitive.
findings.consequence: Equivalence must be established empirically on CUDA; it is not true by construction.

findings.finding: Candidate reconstructs v-u or d-u instead of canonical q-log(lambda).
findings.consequence: Possible cancellation for large positive matched terms; wide-domain tests are mandatory.

findings.finding: Candidate replaces y=0 by an epsilon floor instead of implementing the exact zero boundary.
findings.consequence: The candidate computes a regularized problem at y=0, not the canonical prox.

findings.finding: Fused stencil candidate has no poisson_log mode.
findings.consequence: Stencil coverage is six fidelity modes, not seven.

findings.finding: Candidate wrappers pass runtime strides and use distinct output buffers.
findings.consequence: The intended stride-safe and no-in-place contracts are visible in source, but still require CUDA execution.
